page_note: Heavily damaged page (84.4%) but the visible text is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate. Two teaching units: (1) the Father of Life establishing the hidden ones / First Man / archons / dissolution at the last time / Light to its region, Darkness chained forever; (2) the coming of the Third Ambassador, structured by an extended simile of the 'great king' inspecting his craftsmen, architects, and chiefs in each place — the simile is internal to the cosmic system (it describes the Third Ambassador's cosmic survey), not a contemporary application. Only segment 3 ('Be knowing of this manner') is a didactic transition formula.
